cypress.linePrev: And spend all your mercy and madness and grace
cypress.line: In a day beneath the bending cypress?
stanza: And for the sake of that pit of snakes
For whom did you allay your shyness
And spend all your mercy and madness and grace
In a day beneath the bending cypress?

partner.line: For whom did you allay your shyness

cypress.linePrev: I waited for you on the running boards
cypress.line: Near the cypress trees, while the springtime turned
stanza: Your corrupt ways had finally made you blind
I can’t remember your face anymore
Your mouth has changed, your eyes don’t look into mine
The priest wore black on the seventh day
And sat stone-faced while the building burned
I waited for you on the running boards
Near the cypress trees, while the springtime turned
